Use Conventional Commits convention for the title. Example: feat: add study activity

### Description

Please, provide a brief explanation of the PR that includes what problem or feature is being addressed, whether tests are carried out or not and if so which ones and the summary of the changes made (the most important thing).
Example: This PR implements study activity functionality, allowing you to time and view activity information.

### Additional context

Provide any additional details that may be helpful to test the changes made to the branch.

## Verification list

- [ ] It has been verified that the changes are well integrated into the application.
- [ ] It has been verified that the changes correspond to those requested in the task.
